summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Soft Signals system for Arroba M&A platform. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified signals display correctly on Marketplace, Home featured section, and Deal detail pages. Fixed one minor issue: Marketplace.js deal card links now use /explorar instead of /marketplace.

backend: Internal score NOT exposed in marketplace deals response
Deals sorted by activity (LOI deals near top)
Signal structure has type, text, color fields
Signal text in Spanish (LOIs recibidas, Varios buyers evaluando, etc.)
GET /api/marketplace/featured returns top 6 deals with signals
Featured deals do not expose internal score
Deal page does not expose internal score
Signal hierarchy: LOI signals appear first (highest priority)
Signal colors match types (loi=red, competition=amber, dr_activity=blue, freshness=green)
Deals without activity have empty signals array (clean cards)
Authenticated buyer sees signals on deal page
Authenticated seller sees signals on marketplace
frontend: Marketplace page loads with signals on deal cards
Signal badges visible: LOI (red), Competition (amber), DR Activity (blue), Freshness (green)
Home featured section shows 6 deals with signals
Deal detail page shows signals in header area
Back to marketplace link goes to /explorar
No /marketplace links in DealPage.js or Home.js

context_for_next_testing_agent: Soft Signals system fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) Signals computed based on LOIs, NDA holders, process stage, DR activity, and freshness, 2) Max 2 signals per deal with hierarchy (loi > competition > process > dr_activity > freshness), 3) Internal score used for sorting but never exposed in API, 4) Signal colors: red=LOI, amber=competition/process, blue=DR activity, green=freshness, 5) Spanish text: 'X LOIs recibidas', 'Varios buyers evaluando', 'Varias partes interesadas', 'En fase avanzada', 'Revision activa de documentacion', 'Nuevo esta semana', 'Interes reciente', 6) Deals without activity show no signals (clean cards).
